import sys,time,cProfile,pstats
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication,QTableWidget
from wolflauncher.server_browser_feature import ServerBrowserMixin
from wolflauncher.server_browser_controller import BrowserQuery,BrowserSnapshot
from wolflauncher.models import DiscoveredServer,Server
from wolflauncher.mods import ModCheckResult
from wolflauncher.theme import apply_application_theme,configure_data_table
app=QApplication([]);apply_application_theme(app)
table=QTableWidget(0,18);configure_data_table(table);table.resize(1350,720)
servers=[DiscoveredServer(f'Server {i:04}',f'host{i}',2302,2303,online=i%2==0,status_source='local',players_current=9,players_max=90,game_time='16:56',day_acceleration=1) for i in range(1000)]
window=SimpleNamespace(browser_table=table,browser_detailed_columns=Mock(isChecked=Mock(return_value=False)),selected_discovered_server=Mock(return_value=None),current_browser_query=Mock(return_value=BrowserQuery(limit=1000)),browser_limit=Mock(currentText=Mock(return_value='1000')),servers=[],wolfapi_directory_total=None,discovery_provider_key=Mock(return_value='wolfapi_v1'),browser_summary=Mock(),update_browser_active_filters=Mock(),update_browser_selection_context=Mock(),update_browser_detail_for_key=Mock())
window.configure_browser_columns=lambda:ServerBrowserMixin.configure_browser_columns(window)
window.apply_browser_mod_preview=lambda *args:ServerBrowserMixin.apply_browser_mod_preview(window,*args)
window.browser_mod_results={s.cache_key:(time.monotonic(),ModCheckResult(True,Server(s.name,'G',s.host,2302,2303),[])) for s in servers}
window.configure_browser_columns();table.show();app.processEvents()
summary=dict(total=1000,online=500,seen=1000,checked=1000)
profile=cProfile.Profile();profile.enable()
for rows in (servers,[s for s in servers if s.online],servers):
 start=time.perf_counter();ServerBrowserMixin.apply_browser_snapshot(window,BrowserSnapshot(rows,len(rows),summary));app.processEvents();print(len(rows),round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000,2))
profile.disable();pstats.Stats(profile).sort_stats('cumtime').print_stats(14)
table.close()
